state_data.candidate_profile:
Recent B.Tech graduate in Computer Technology with hands-on experience as an AI Engineer Intern.

Experience:
- Developed LLM-powered applications using LangChain and LangGraph.
- Built advanced RAG systems using hybrid retrieval, BM25, vector search, reranking, and embeddings.
- Worked with FastAPI to build and integrate AI backends.
- Developed AI voice agents and workflow automation using n8n and VAPI.
- Worked with HuggingFace, ChromaDB, FAISS, and various LLM APIs.
- Implemented AI-powered chatbots and document question-answering systems.
- Experience in model evaluation, prompt engineering, and debugging AI applications.

Skills:
Python, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Transformers, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, FastAPI, SQL, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, REST APIs.
state_data.job_description:
AI Engineer

We are looking for an AI Engineer with experience in Python, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs).

Responsibilities:
- Develop and deploy AI/ML models using Python.
- Build LLM-powered applications using LangChain and LangGraph.
- Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
- Integrate AI models with REST APIs using FastAPI.
- Work with vector databases such as FAISS, ChromaDB, and Pinecone.
- Perform data preprocessing, model evaluation, and optimization.
- Develop AI agents and automated workflows.
- Implement prompt engineering and structured output generation.
- Debug, test, and optimize AI applications.

Requirements:
- Strong Python programming skills.
- Understanding of ML, DL, NLP, and Transformers.
- Practical experience with LLMs, embeddings, and RAG.
- Knowledge of API development and integration.
- Understanding of model evaluation metrics and AI system reliability.
- Familiarity with Git, databases, and deployment.

The candidate should demonstrate strong technical fundamentals, problem-solving ability, and practical AI engineering knowledge.
